sizes: Distinct channels in the last full week, grouped by current live viewer count. A channel may appear in more than one band during a week. Counts below 5 are shown as <5 and excluded from shares.
ticks: Tick outcomes in this period. Fired counts published messages.
timers: Enabled timers in enabled modules. Options can overlap; plain has none.
rounds: Completed rounds by game and outcome in this period.
entrants: Rounds grouped by entrant count. Empty rounds have no entrant bucket.
points: Successful point operations, counted once per operation, not by amount.
rewards: Matched reward redemptions by feature and result in this period.
login: Authorization starts, successful logins and rejection reasons in this period. Counts are events, not unique people.
trials: Trials whose counter promotion completed in this period.
moderation: Detected rules split by shadow and enforced actions in this period.
runtime: Current runtime state of counted accounts.
desktop: Unrevoked grants with both refresh deadlines still in the future.
signups: New accounts created on each day of the window.
gainLoss: New accounts against deleted accounts on each day.
funnel: Signups, finished setups and bot enables in the window. Each step counts events in the window, so later steps can include earlier signups.
churn: Bot disabled, access revoked, accounts deleted and chat bans, summed over the window.
presets: Setup presets picked during onboarding, summed over the window.
active: Channels the bot served on each day of the window.
live: Channels that went live on each day of the window.
messages: Chat messages the bot read on each day of the window.
answered: Commands the bot answered on each day of the window.
activity: Totals over the window, plus channels live in the last full week.
cohorts: Share served in each completed, covered week. Blank cells are future or uncovered weeks. Incomplete signup weeks are excluded.
plans: Accounts by plan in the latest daily snapshot, how many of each have the bot enabled, and paid plans waiting to cancel or on a failed payment.
sources: Paid accounts by how the plan was granted, in the latest daily snapshot.
billing: Billing events summed over the window.
conversion: For each of the last 12 signup weeks, accounts in the latest daily snapshot and how many are paid.
modules: On includes default-enabled accounts without a stored setting. Adoption is on / all accounts in the latest snapshot. Activation is active channels last full week / currently on. Outputs and toggles cover the window.
breadth: Channels grouped by how many modules they have on, in the latest daily snapshot.
integrations: Accounts with each integration connected and their share of all accounts in the latest daily snapshot.
pagesHidden: Accounts that hide each public page, in the latest daily snapshot.
builtIn: Top 30 built-in commands by uses over the window, with uses and channels in the last full week.
custom: Custom commands created, deleted and used over the window, and the latest daily snapshot of their totals.
perms: Custom commands by who may run them, in the latest daily snapshot.
flags: Custom commands by option, in the latest daily snapshot.
locales: Accounts by interface language, in the latest daily snapshot.
activationAge: Distinct channels served in the last full week, grouped by account age when served.
onboarding: Setup events over the window, plus onboarded accounts and their share of all accounts in the latest snapshot.
imports: Preview and commit results over the window, grouped by import source.
signupSources: Logins started and new accounts over the window, by the site that sent the visitor.
checkout: Checkout results by plan. Activation share compares activation events with redirected checkouts in the window, including earlier checkouts.
dashboard: Views over the window, with counts split between account owners and delegates.
recipeRuns: Runs over the window by trigger, plus distinct channels using recipes in the last full week.
recipeOutcomes: All runs, successful runs and the failed share of all runs over the window.
recipeTotals: Enabled and disabled recipes in the latest daily snapshot.
drops: Window totals by send kind and drop reason.
dailyDrops: All dropped sends on each day of the window.
providers: Calls over the window. Error share includes every result other than success.
songs: Request outcomes over the window. Success means the song was queued.
blocked: Blocked events as a share of command uses plus blocked events over the window.
delegating: Accounts with at least one delegate and their share of all accounts in the latest daily snapshot.
donations: Gross Ko-fi payments in the window by currency, with the recurring share and the previous window of equal length. Amounts are before Ko-fi and payment processor fees.
donationMonths: Gross Ko-fi payments per calendar month over the last 12 months, closed UTC days only.
donationKinds: Ko-fi payments in the window by type.
